# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** 18 years old in the summer of 1891  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v2 c26 P45](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0045), [v3 c1 P16](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0016)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v4 c1 P1](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0001), [v4 c4 P11](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0011)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope, Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014)</sub>
- **Role:** Housewife and mother  <sub>[v4 c1 P1](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0001), [v4 c1 P6](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0006)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Di  <sub>[v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025), [v3 c1 P17](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0017)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with black eyes, rosy cheeks, and a merry, dark-complexioned face featuring alluring dimples. She has long, glossy, black hair and a plump, well-rounded figure. As she grows into young womanhood, she matures into a pleasantly stout, matronly woman.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v3 c33 P13](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0013), [v4 c1 P1](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0001), [v4 c1 P25](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0025)_

## Personality

Diana is a sensible, cheerful, and loyal companion with a fondness for laughter and practical amusements. While she lacks Anne's wild imagination, she is an enthusiastic, affectionate, and deeply unselfish friend who holds her sworn bonds of fellowship sacred. Though occasionally prone to timidness or conventional anxieties, her warm-heartedness and devotion to her family and loved ones are steadfast.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c21 P17](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0017), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042)_

## Goals

- To maintain a lifelong, unbreakable friendship with Anne Shirley  <sub>[v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005), [v2 c26 P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060)</sub>
- To build a happy home and family with Fred Wright  <sub>[v2 c29 P24](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0024), [v2 c29 P28](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0028)</sub>

## History

Diana Barry meets Anne Shirley shortly after the latter arrives in Avonlea, and the two young girls solemnly pledge an oath of eternal friendship over running water in the Barry garden. Diana attends the Avonlea school alongside Anne, sharing a desk, games, and childhood secrets. Their friendship faces a temporary crisis when Diana inadvertently becomes intoxicated on Marilla's homemade currant wine, leading Mrs. Barry to forbid the girls from playing together. However, after Anne successfully treats Diana's little sister Minnie May for a life-threatening case of croup during a winter storm, Mrs. Barry relents and reinstates their companionship. As the girls grow up, Diana participates in local events, including the Avonlea Debating Club concerts, the Story Club, and the Avonlea Village Improvement Society. After Anne leaves to attend Queen's Academy and later Redmond College, Diana remains at Orchard Slope, maintaining an affectionate correspondence with Anne. During this time she becomes courted by Fred Wright, a young Avonlea farmer. The two eventually become engaged, and in the summer following Anne's graduation from Redmond College, Diana marries Fred in an old-fashioned wedding at Orchard Slope with Anne as her bridesmaid. The couple settles at their farm in Avonlea, where Diana gives birth to two children, Fred Jr. and Small Anne Cordelia.

## Background by volume

- Born in February at Orchard Slope, Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c19 P9](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0009)</sub>
- Named by a schoolmaster who boarded with her parents when she was born  <sub>[v1 c2 P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064)</sub>
- Raised in a strict household by her parents, George and Mrs. Barry  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014), [v2 c13 P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051)</sub>

## Quotes

> I solemnly swear to be faithful to my bosom friend, Anne Shirley, as long as the sun and moon shall endure.  <sub>[v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036)</sub>

> I’ll never have another bosom friend—I don’t want to have. I couldn’t love anybody as I love you.  <sub>[v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005)</sub>

> I’m so happy, but it does seem ridiculous to think of me being engaged.  <sub>[v2 c29 P16](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0016)</sub>

> We are not really parting, Anne. I’m not going far away. We’ll love each other just as much as ever.  <sub>[v4 c1 P3](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0003)</sub>
